name: Triple Pairing
original_name: トリプルペアリング -Triple Pairing-
source:
What would you do if two polar-opposite girls confessed their love for you at the exact same time? Love isn't a spectator sport. The thrill of romance comes from figuring out what kind of girl you want to be with and what kind of love you want to pursue.

In Triple Pairing, the love triangle mechanic will constantly force you to make a choice. You must decide, of your own free will, which one of the heroines you choose. The more thoughtful and deliberate that journey is, the deeper your love for the heroine you've chosen will be.

These six girls will do everything they can to win your affection. Watch them put their hearts on the line and see their genuine unguarded charm shine through.
